sentences.en: Quite a lot of rotten apples were in the basket.
I want a basket in which to carry these apples.
sentences.zh: 我想要一个能装这些苹果的篮子。

sentences.en: We received instructions on how to make a bamboo basket.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了如何用竹子编篮子的指示。

phrases.zh: 编织篮子（通常指作为休闲活动）

senses.zh: 把…装入篮内；把…丢入字纸篓里
